title: thyssenkrupp Uhde High Pressure Technologies
content: thyssenkrupp Uhde High Pressure Technologies is a German process-equipment supplier with official application content focused on drying aerogels using supercritical CO2. The company explains that aerogels produced through sol-gel processing require careful solvent removal to protect the pore structure, and positions supercritical drying systems as a practical route for this step. This makes the company relevant for aerogel process design, equipment sourcing, and industrial drying workflows.
